crossRefs.keyword: and the things which shall be

translations.web: Write therefore the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will happen hereafter.
translations.bsb: Therefore write down the things you have seen, the things that are, and the things that will happen after this.
translations.kjv: Write the things which thou hast seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter;
translations.asv: Write therefore the things which thou sawest, and the things which are, and the things which shall come to pass hereafter;
